message: The Today widget now keeps up while the app is closed. A task you deferred to later appears on the widget when it's due, the day turns over at your day start time, and if the widget hasn't been updated in two days it asks you to open the app instead of showing an old list. Daily targets show their count (3/8), and checking one off on the widget logs one unit instead of finishing the whole target. The small widget also says how many more tasks it couldn't fit.
